structure Context where
  quotContext        : Name
  preserveOrder      : Bool
  /-- When creating binders for abstracted metavariables, we use the following `BinderInfo`. -/
  binderInfoForMVars : BinderInfo := BinderInfo.implicit

  mvarIdsToAbstract  : MVarIdSet := {}
